positions.name: CalibrationVerificationGround
positions.frame: What grounds the calibration claim — the instrument's own reading, or its agreement with an external reference standard?
positions.why: All three expressions assert the same calibration fact but ground it identically: the 88.4 MHz figure is not offered as a bare instrument reading but as a value 'verified against the June reference plates.' src-1 states this in prose with plain-assertion conviction and expert/rational-persuasion footing; src-2 and src-3 restate the same instrument-and-calibration facts as structured field labels under Xena's animator/author footing, in the same flat technical register. The directional read spanning all three is deference to an external standard as the basis for the claim, not authority claimed by rank — no tension, just the same ground reasserted across prose and log-entry form.
